mapper.update: MERGE INTO pipeline_task (id, state, template_name, graph_json, input_paths, total_files, success_files, failed_files, error_node, error_message, update_time) KEY(id) VALUES (#{id}, #{state}, #{templateName}, #{graphJson}, #{inputPaths}, #{totalFiles}, #{successFiles}, #{failedFiles}, #{errorNode}, #{errorMessage}, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP)

INSERT INTO pipeline_task (id, state, template_name, graph_json, input_paths, total_files, success_files, failed_files, error_node, error_message, update_time) VALUES (#{id}, #{state}, #{templateName}, #{graphJson}, #{inputPaths}, #{totalFiles}, #{successFiles}, #{failedFiles}, #{errorNode}, #{errorMessage}, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE state = VALUES(state), template_name = VALUES(template_name), graph_json = VALUES(graph_json), input_paths = VALUES(input_paths), total_files = VALUES(total_files), success_files = VALUES(success_files), failed_files = VALUES(failed_files), error_node = VALUES(error_node), error_message = VALUES(error_message), update_time = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
UPDATE pipeline_task SET state = #{state}, update_time = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE id = #{id}
UPDATE pipeline_task SET state = #{state}, duration_ms = #{durationMs}, update_time = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE id = #{id}

UPDATE pipeline_task SET total_files = COALESCE(#{totalFiles}, total_files), success_files = COALESCE(#{successFiles}, success_files), failed_files = COALESCE(#{failedFiles}, failed_files), error_node = COALESCE(#{errorNode}, error_node), error_message = COALESCE(#{errorMessage}, error_message), update_time = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.select: SELECT id, state, template_name AS templateName, graph_json AS graphJson, input_paths AS inputPaths, total_files AS totalFiles, success_files AS successFiles, failed_files AS failedFiles, error_node AS errorNode, error_message AS errorMessage, create_time AS createTime, update_time AS updateTime FROM pipeline_task WHERE id = #{id}

SELECT id, state, template_name AS templateName, graph_json AS graphJson, input_paths AS inputPaths, total_files AS totalFiles, success_files AS successFiles, failed_files AS failedFiles, error_node AS errorNode, error_message AS errorMessage, create_time AS createTime, update_time AS updateTime FROM pipeline_task WHERE state NOT IN ('COMPLETED', 'FAILED', 'CANCELLED') ORDER BY create_time ASC

SELECT id, state, template_name AS templateName, graph_json AS graphJson, input_paths AS inputPaths, total_files AS totalFiles, success_files AS successFiles, failed_files AS failedFiles, error_node AS errorNode, error_message AS errorMessage, create_time AS createTime, update_time AS updateTime FROM pipeline_task ORDER BY create_time DESC
